reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data and pre-existing IP with only a limited processing right to Vendor, § 14.2 contains a present assignment of Deliverables (plus personnel assignments and further assurances), § 14.3 limits Vendor to Vendor Technology and channels embedded Vendor IP into the § 13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence, and § 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a signed instrument setting exploitation rights.

The § 1.8 Vendor Technology definition expressly excludes Customer Data and Customer pre-existing IP, and § 15.1 bars sale, advertising use, data combination and model training without consent — no walk-away trigger (no assignment of Customer IP/data to Vendor, no unrestricted joint ownership) is present.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, and the deterministic check ('no assignment of Customer Data/IP to Vendor remains') passes.

The rationale's acknowledged narrowing (Deliverables limited to items an Order Form identifies as created specifically for Customer; ownership subject to payment of Fees) is ordinary scoping that does not fall below the preferred position and is correctly flagged as not warranting a redline.
